cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. At the house meeting, back me up about the bins being Alex's turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Only on the old rota. Remember the new conversation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're having it now. Try to remember it confidently.
